Catalyst

Weapon Types

Catalysts are one of the five weapon types that characters can use in Genshin Impact.

All Normal and Charged Attacks of Catalyst users deal elemental damage.

Normal Attacks[]

A Catalyst user's Normal Attack chain typically consists of 3–4 single-target or AoE elemental attacks from range. These attacks take varying forms depending on the character, and their maximum ranges vary greatly between characters.

Catalyst Normal Attacks have the following types:

  • Projectile: Fire projectiles of various forms that home towards their target. Since these attacks are projectiles, characters with this type of attack may still hit targets out of their targeting range if positioned correctly. (e.g., Ningguang's Sparkling Scatter, Sangonomiya Kokomi's The Shape of Water)
  • Non-Projectile: Will hit the target near instantaneously at range, and it is impossible for them to hit targets out of range. (e.g., Lisa's Lightning Touch, Sucrose's Wind Spirit Creation)
  • Fixed Hitbox: Have fixed AoE hitboxes originating from the character's location. Hitbox-based Catalyst attacks can also be melee attacks. (e.g., Yae Miko's Spiritfox Sin-Eater, Nahida's Akara, Shikanoin Heizou's Fudou Style Martial Arts)

Charged Attacks[]

Catalyst users' Charged Attacks typically consume 50 stamina to unleash a more powerful AoE attack after a short delay. The default version of attacks of this type spawns at the target's location when locked on.

Some of the exceptions to this default version are:

  • Charged Attack: Sparkling Scatter in which Ningguang fires one large homing projectile that deals damage in a small AoE on hit.
  • Charged Attack: Wind Spirit Creation in which Sucrose conjures a conical blast of wind that hits targets in an AoE in front of her.
  • Charged Attack: Spiritfox Sin-Eater in which Yae Miko reigns down multiple strikes of lightning in a zigzag pattern that can hit twice on a single large enough target.
  • Charged Attack: Fudou Style Martial Arts where Heizou performs a melee attack in the form of an upward kick at the cost of 25 stamina.
  • Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment where Neuvillette can move and change directions while unleashing surging torrents without consuming stamina.
  • Charged Attack: Forceful Fists of Frost where Wriothesley performs a melee attack in the form of a leaping uppercut.
  • Charged Attack: Word of Wind and Flower where Xianyun shoots a projectile forwards following terrain height that can pierce and damage opponents along the way.
  • Charged Attack: Shadow-Stealing Spirit Vessel whereby entering aiming mode, Citlali shoots a projectile in a straight line that can pierce and damage opponents along the way. This can be done mid-air and, while in aiming mode, Citlali floats and consumes 20 stamina or phlogiston per second.
  • Charged Attack: Black Pheasant Strides on Water where Lan Yan throws her ring forward following terrain height that hits targets three times in a small AoE once impacted.
  • Charged Attack: By the Horns in which Varesa at first does a hop forward and then leaps high into the air which then allows her to do a Plunging Attack.
  • Charged Attack: Rite of Dispelling Winds in which Ifa discharges a shot traveling in a straight line that explodes in a small AoE.

Plunging Attacks[]

Most Catalyst users have similar animations when plunging, which involves them turning into a glowing elemental ball and reappearing upon striking the ground. The exceptions being Xianyun in her Cloud Transmogrification state, Varesa, and Ifa in his Nightsoul's Blessing state.

Most catalyst Plunging Attacks are considered ranged attacks and cannot deal any damage to Geo objects such as Minerals with the only exception being Varesa.
